fusions.name: Long Pounce
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. You pounce up to 7 tiles onto it for 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Raking Flurry
fusions.desc: Rakes both hands through a cone 2 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each target [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Midair Twist
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 15% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Always Lands Upright
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
